events.description: Ross Geller says Andr will arrive in about 45 minutes.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green told Chandler Bing about the last dream.
Chandler Bing tells Rachel Green to continue talking about the dream.
Rachel Green tells Chandler Bing to forget discussing the dream.
Chandler Bing asks whether Chandler Bing did anything particularly saucy in Rachel Green's dream.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing was not the only one in Rachel Green's dream and Joey Tribbiani was there too.
Ross Geller asks whether anyone else was in Rachel Green's dream.
Ross Geller asks Rachel Green if Rachel Green is sure about the details of the dream.
Ross Geller asks whether anyone handed out mints in Rachel Green's dream.
Rachel Green says the dream involved only Joey Tribbiani, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing.
Joey Tribbiani asks whether Rachel Green's dream had Rachel Green with Chandler Bing, Rachel Green with Joey Tribbiani, or all three together.
Rachel Green asks Joey Tribbiani if Joey Tribbiani knows what Rachel Green is about to say.
Rachel Green says there were times in the dream when the woman was not Rachel Green.
Phoebe Buffay says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing are being very sweet.
Rachel Green says Young Ethan called Monica Geller again.
Ross Geller asks Monica Geller if Monica Geller is no longer seeing Young Ethan.
Monica Geller says everyone knows that sometimes relationships do not work out.
Monica Geller says sometimes relationships like Monica Geller and Young Ethan's do not work out.

Chandler Bing says Monica Geller ending her relationship with Young Ethan has nothing to do with the fact that Young Ethan needs a note to get out of gym, and Chandler Bing says Young Ethan needs a note to get out of gym.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green did not say anything about Monica Geller and Young Ethan and swears it.
Rachel Green says Young Ethan stopped by earlier.
Joey Tribbiani tells Monica Geller to listen.
Joey Tribbiani asks Monica Geller to ask Young Ethan, the next time Monica Geller talks to Young Ethan, which Power Ranger is the strongest.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller's life is so amusing.
Monica Geller asks everyone to drop the subject of Monica Geller's relationship with Young Ethan.
Ross Geller declares that it is Morphin time like in Power Rangers.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has to go.
Rachel Green asks where Phoebe Buffay is going.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has a birthday party to attend with some coworkers.
Chandler Bing says nobody told Chandler Bing about the coworkers' birthday party.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay knows that the coworkers did not tell Chandler Bing about the party.
Phoebe Buffay says not being told about the party is part of Chandler Bing's coworkers not liking Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not understand why Chandler Bing's coworkers now exclude Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing's coworkers were Chandler Bing's friends a month ago.
Chandler Bing says that just because Chandler Bing is in charge does not mean Chandler Bing is a different person.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing knows what Phoebe Buffay means.
Phoebe Buffay suggests Chandler Bing should come to the coworkers' birthday party tonight, hang out with the coworkers, and let the coworkers see that Chandler Bing is still a great guy.
Chandler Bing asks Phoebe Buffay whether Phoebe Buffay thinks Chandler Bing should go to the coworkers' birthday party tonight.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay really thinks Chandler Bing should go to the coworkers' birthday party tonight.
Phoebe Buffay asks that Phoebe Buffay and Chandler Bing not go to the coworkers' birthday party together.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay does not want to be seen as the geek who invited her boss, Chandler Bing, to the party.
